description: Control the Seeed Studio reBot Arm B601: 6-DoF Damiao (B601-DM) or RobStride (B601-RS) arm with per-variant kinematics, collision geometry and 3D models, motion-service support, and the DM parallel gripper.

models.short_description: 6-DoF reBot B601 arm (DM and RS): streamed trajectories, motion-service moves, per-variant kinematics and collision geometry
B601-DM parallel gripper with force-capped grab, hold detection, and frame kinematics
Finds attached B601 USB-CAN boards by USB id and proposes arm + gripper configs
